decisions.reason: After another year in a growing market, this close-to-core express offer is easy for management to defend as a capacity and service commitment worth sustaining.

Although the seventy-two-hour promise remains operationally demanding, sunk implementation effort and its fit with the firm's fast-service positioning still make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

This certified fire-resistant exterior door is highly aligned with the firm's core safety business and public product architecture, so prior development and visible commitment strongly favor keeping it.
A dedicated express line with multiple models reflects substantial resource commitment and public market positioning, which under escalation of commitment makes exit unlikely.
The online ordering and digital services platform is strategically central to the firm's stated move toward deeper advisory and service support, so management is very likely to persist with it.

Because it extends the established fire and smoke protection portfolio and reinforces the firm's compliance-oriented value proposition, management would normally continue it absent clearly adverse evidence.
